name: Cranberry
siboNotes: Fresh cranberries are well-tolerated on SIBO diets due to their low FODMAP content and natural antimicrobial properties.
preparationTips: Choose fresh cranberries over dried versions which often contain high-FODMAP sweeteners
Can be cooked into sauces with maple syrup or stevia instead of regular sugar
Freeze fresh cranberries to use year-round in smoothies and baking
Rinse and remove any soft or damaged berries before use
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
Contains proanthocyanidins which support urinary tract health
Good source of fiber for digestive health
Low in natural sugars compared to most fruits
